reason: The README clearly describes a plugin that provides two agent tools for one-way Markdown and plain-text notifications to DingTalk groups through a configured webhook.

summaries.zh: 通过钉钉自定义机器人 Webhook 向群聊发送 Markdown 或纯文本通知。
summaries.en: Sends Markdown or plain-text notifications to DingTalk groups through a configured custom-robot webhook.

capabilities: Sends Markdown or plain-text messages to a configured DingTalk group via webhook
Uses an optional HMAC-SHA256 signature for DingTalk webhook requests
Reads webhook and optional signing-secret configuration or environment variable
